column3: (Storable and Cacheable Content: every response carries Cache-Control: no-store; ZAP's informational rule)
(Timestamp Disclosure: the page shows the server time and migration times on purpose)
(Authentication Request Identified: informational; the spider may submit the sign-in form, which is refused without the interface's own Origin)

(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens: the sign-in form carries none on purpose; every POST is refused unless its Origin names the interface host (originAllowed, src/server/auth.ts:148, called before any POST is read in src/server/http.ts), and the session cookie is SameSite=Strict (src/server/auth.ts:76); every POST after sign-in also carries a session-bound CSRF token)
